faq.q: What is Misfire Games in GTA VI?
faq.a: It is the in-universe game developer referenced through a Righteous Slaughter: Hood Ops T-shirt worn by San4San in the Extended Look video, as identified by GamesRadar+.

faq.q: Is Righteous Slaughter a real game series in GTA?
faq.a: It is a fictional in-universe game series. GamesRadar+ notes this T-shirt is a callback to Righteous Slaughter 7, which appeared in GTA 5.

faq.q: Who wears the Misfire Games related shirt in the Extended Look?
faq.a: The character San4San, who appears near the start of the video wearing the Righteous Slaughter: Hood Ops shirt.

faq.q: Does Misfire Games appear anywhere else in GTA VI?
faq.a: The facts file only records the one T-shirt reference. No other in-game appearance of Misfire Games is confirmed.
